dct_title_s: Fremont County, Iowa, 1938, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet label. Image is a photoreduction of the mosaic created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol BKA; form of individual image numbering: BKA-1-[number], BKA-2-[number], BKA-3-[number], BKA-4-[number], BKA-5-[number], or BKA-6-[number]."Date of completion December 7, 1938" Flown by Iowa Aerial Surveys, Des Moines, Iowa. "Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made]. Library's copy 2 consists of photographic negatives (4 x 5 in.) corresponding to each of the images in its copy 1.
